criteria.description: Workbook opens and contains Statement_Header, Transactions, Categories, Reconciliation, Provenance, and Checks.
Account identity, period, currency, and opening/statement closing balances match the supplied statement.
Each statement transaction is represented once with the correct date, description, debit/credit direction, amount, and page, independent of row order or candidate-assigned ID.
Transaction IDs are non-empty and unique, and transaction/provenance populations are complete without duplicates.
Every transaction net amount is a formula that evaluates to credit minus debit.
Opening balance, total credits, total debits, and calculated closing balance are formula-linked and reconcile to the statement balance.
Both manifest-selected transaction changes—a credit and a distinct debit—update reconciliation and category totals while preserving unrelated balances and categories.
Category labels are semantically valid and category values are formula-linked to the signed transaction table, independent of label wording or row order.
Each transaction ID links once to the correct statement file/page with a candidate-readable locator; no private locator token is required.
Penalty for omitted/duplicated transactions, reversed debit/credit logic, stale closing balance, invalid category semantics, or false page provenance.
